summary: Frontend-only responsive audit executed on public preview across required matrix (320x568, 360x800, 390x844, 430x932, 568x320, 844x390). Verified all V0 routes with screenshots and bounds capture, including live rare states via isolated localStorage fixtures. TypeScript and domain/chrono regression scripts passed.

ui_bugs.issue: At 568x320, measured live arena and side team columns exceed viewport bottom before user scroll (arena bottom=345, team columns bottom=329/338 for vh=320).
Reduced-height keyboard simulation shows preset input touching/overlapping footer by ~1px (input_bottom 480 > footer_top 479), causing tight visual collision near CTA rail.
At 320 width, resume subtitle and mode card secondary text become hard to read (multi-line compression/truncation feel). No horizontal overflow, but readability degrades.

issues: Primary live block requires immediate scroll to fully reveal lower arena content in compact landscape.

action_items: Adjust live landscape compact layout so key arena/team block fits within first viewport at 568x320 without initial clipping impression.
Slightly increase spacing behavior between bottom custom preset input and config footer CTA rail in reduced-height scenarios.
Review compact text fitting strategy on Home active-resume state (keep hierarchy, improve readability at 320 width).
Optional QA enhancement: add group-level testIDs for segmented groups (e.g., draw-rule container) to improve deterministic responsive measurements.
critical_code_review_comments: No horizontal page overflow detected in matrix (scrollWidth == clientWidth on tested routes/viewports).
Live timer size requirement validated: 104px on all portrait widths tested (320/360/390/430).
Giant chrono landscape controls remained inside viewport at 568x320 and 844x390 (close/pause/time bounds in-frame).
app/live.tsx is large (~600 lines). Consider splitting presentation subcomponents for maintainability (not a functional defect).
seed_data_creation: Created isolated browser-context fixtures in localStorage keys roundr.session.v1, roundr.summary.v1, roundr.presets.v1 for populated/rare-state responsive validation only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed full viewport matrix route sweep with measured bounds and screenshots. Rare live stages validated through fixture mutation: break, awaitPeriod, additional, extra, golden, shootout, finished. Not fully exercised in this run: real native keyboard/insets behavior on device, tieChoice flow via true domain progression, NativeAlert destructive confirmations, native sharing/audio behavior.
rca_of_issue: RCA: Remaining responsive findings are layout-density issues under compact constraints (especially landscape 568x320) rather than hard overflow bugs. Core structure adapts and scroll fallback works, but first-fold fit/readability can still be optimized without changing visual hierarchy.
